review_locator: PMCID:PMC3730142, IL-17A and Th17 Cells in Lung Inflammation; PMCID:PMC4623590, Regulation of Airway MUC5AC Expression by IL-1beta and IL-17A
primary_title: Regulation of airway MUC5AC expression by IL-1beta and IL-17A; the NF-kappaB paradigm
decision_basis: The reviews identify airway mucin induction as an IL-17A epithelial output; the cited primary shows IL-17A-dependent MUC5AC mRNA and protein induction, promoter-reporter activation, p65/NF-kappaB dependence, and primary-cell support.
limitations_preserved: Human airway epithelial context; MUC5AC transcript is distinct from mucin protein polymerization/secretion and downstream mucus accumulation; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3730142, IL-17A and Th17 Cells in Lung Inflammation; PMCID:PMC4623590, Regulation of Airway MUC5AC Expression by IL-1beta and IL-17A
primary_title: Stimulation of airway mucin gene expression by interleukin (IL)-17 through IL-6 paracrine/autocrine loop
decision_basis: The reviews identify MUC5B as an IL-17 epithelial mucin output; the cited primary shows IL-17-dependent MUC5B gene expression in differentiated primary human tracheobronchial epithelium with monkey and mouse epithelial comparators, partly mediated through an IL-6 autocrine/paracrine loop.
limitations_preserved: IL-6-mediated intermediate is explicit in the primary, so this is an output bridge rather than a direct IL17A-to-MUC5B molecular binding claim; distinguish MUC5B transcript from mucin secretion; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3730142, IL-17A and Th17 Cells in Lung Inflammation
primary_title: IL-17A induces CCL28, supporting the chemotaxis of IgE-secreting B cells
decision_basis: The review identifies CCL28 as an IL-17A-induced airway chemokine; the cited primary reports CCL28 transcription and translation after IL-17A stimulation in primary human airway cells and A549 cells, with conditioned-medium chemotaxis blocked by anti-CCL28 or anti-CCR10.
limitations_preserved: Human airway comparator; CCL28 transcript is distinct from secreted chemokine and subsequent CCR10-dependent migration; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3730142, IL-17A and Th17 Cells in Lung Inflammation; PMCID:PMC2667118, Structure-function relationships in the IL-17 receptor
primary_title: Claudins regulate the intestinal barrier in response to immune mediators
decision_basis: The reviews identify claudin regulation as an IL-17 epithelial barrier output; the cited primary shows IL-17-induced CLDN1 gene transcription in human intestinal T84 monolayers alongside barrier formation and ERK/MEK dependence.
limitations_preserved: Human intestinal epithelial context; CLDN1 transcript is distinct from tight-junction assembly and barrier function; primary used historical IL-17 nomenclature, retained here as IL17A with that boundary; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7072868, Interleukin-17A and Keratinocytes in Psoriasis
primary_title: Interleukin 17 Promotes Expression of Alarmins S100A8 and S100A9 During the Inflammatory Response of Keratinocytes
decision_basis: The review identifies S100A8 as an IL-17-associated keratinocyte output; the cited primary shows IL-17A/F-induced S100A8 mRNA and protein in primary murine keratinocytes, with stronger expression during early maturation.
limitations_preserved: Murine keratinocyte/psoriasis-like context; S100A8 transcript is distinct from calprotectin complex formation and release; primary supports IL17A/F family stimulation rather than IL17A-only exclusivity; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
